name: H and H Blueberry The Berry Patch
tagline: H & H Blueberry / The Berry Patch
description: H and H Blueberry The Berry Patch is a family-run farm in Red Level, AL. It grows Blueberries, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
